1

What is this event? (read this first)

The Festival Special Event is a combined Christmas-season event. Members check in daily for rewards, complete daily missions by betting / depositing to earn cash bonuses, and collect the event item PAROL (Christmas star lantern), which they then use for prize pool draws (including physical grand prizes). Together this forms a loop: “Check in → Bet / Deposit → Claim rewards / Earn PAROL → Prize pool draw → Bet again”.

The four ways to play at a glance

Daily Check-inTap “today” on the calendar to check in and claim the reward. From the 3rd consecutive day, a random check-in chest (Christmas Surprise Chest) is also opened. Missing a day restarts the count from Day 1.
Parol Quest
(Daily missions)		Called “Daily Rebate Config” in the back office. When a member’s valid bets or deposits for the day reach each level’s target, they can claim a cash bonus manually; some levels trigger a card-flip challenge when claimed (win = boost), or give extra PAROL. Configured by VIP level and reset daily at 00:00.
Special mission
(Christmas Mission)		Every time cumulative valid bets during the event reach the target, PAROL is issued automatically, with no limit on repeats. The system settles, issues PAROL and updates progress every 20 minutes; members don’t need to claim.
Parol Wish Draw
(Prize pool draws)		4 fixed prize pools with 9 rewards each, drawn with PAROL (1 / 5 / 10 draws). The center is the Grand Prize (the reward with the lowest win rate), which can be a physical prize.

Two key time points

Next-day make-up claimDaily mission cash bonuses (incl. bonus PAROL) that were reached the previous day but not claimed can be claimed via a pop-up the next day when the member enters the platform homepage. Only the previous day can be made up; anything older expires.
Redemption period3 days starting the day after the event ends: members can only draw with their remaining PAROL; no check-in and no bet / deposit counting. After the 3 days the entrance closes and remaining PAROL expires.
🧭Your main job in the back office: use “Add / Edit event” to configure check-in, daily missions, challenges, prize pools and the special mission, then switch the event on. All payouts are auto-approved by the system (incl. physical prizes). CS needs to know what members see on the front end (Chapter 7, with real screens) and handle shipping arrangements for physical prizes.
2

Before you start · Key notes at a glance

The points below are the easiest to get wrong and have the biggest impact — remember them before you start. Later chapters explain each one again.

① Only one Festival Special Event can be on at a time. You can create several (saved as “Off”), but if one is already running when you switch another “On”, it is blocked with the error 检测到相同活动正在进行中 (“The same event is already running”). To start a new one, switch off or delete the old one first.
② After the event ends there is a 3-day redemption period, after which all PAROL expires. Redemption period = from 00:00 the day after the end date to the end time +3 days, calculated automatically and not editable; only draws are allowed. After +3 days the entrance closes and members’ remaining PAROL expires.
③ Status “Off” = the front-end entrance closes immediately (with a confirmation prompt). While off: members cannot enter the event page and cannot draw; bets / deposits in that period are not counted and not back-filled; if it stays off for a whole day, members’ check-in streak breaks. Rewards and PAROL already earned are kept, and the event resumes according to its current stage when switched back on.
④ Every “win rate” set must total exactly 100%. The 9 rewards of each check-in chest, the 9 rewards of each prize pool, and the check-in “random chest win rate” — if the total isn’t 100% it turns red and blocks the next step. Win rates allow up to 4 decimal places (e.g. 0.0125).
⑤ Challenge “trigger rates” must not total more than 100%, and all three fields accept integers only. Reward boost, trigger rate and win chance do not accept decimals. If trigger rates total less than 100%, the remainder goes to the challenge with the highest trigger rate — levels with “Trigger” ticked always flip a card when claimed.
⑥ “Apply to other levels” cannot be edited once ticked. After ticking it in Daily Rebate Config, all other VIP levels use the VIP0 configuration and can no longer be changed. Make sure VIP0 is correct before ticking.
⑦ If a reward is a “Golden Draw Ticket”, the fallback cash bonus is required. When the Golden Draw (jackpot) event is off, or the member is on the Golden Draw blacklist, the drawn ticket is replaced by this cash bonus. Leaving it empty blocks the next step.
⑧ Physical prizes are issued automatically, but CS must arrange shipping offline. Reward audit is always auto-approved; the front end only tells the member to “contact Customer Service”. Prize name, prize value and thumbnail are all required for physical prizes.
⑨ Cash bonus wagering multiplier: cannot be 0. Up to 2 decimal places; for no requirement, leave it blank — do not enter 0. The multiplier applies to all cash bonuses in this event.
⏱️Data source and updates: daily mission progress uses the member game report as its data source; special-mission PAROL is settled, issued and updated by the system every 20 minutes. It is normal for progress not to change right after a member bets. All “daily” day changes follow UTC+8 00:00.
3

Event list: view and manage events

In the back office, “Event Config (New)” shows the event list, where you can search, add, edit, switch on / off and delete events.

1Search / filterFind events by template (choose “Festival Special Event”), event ID, event name or status.
2Add eventCreates a new event and opens the six-step wizard (see Chapter 4). The configuration tables are blank on the Add page.
3EditEdits an existing event and loads its current configuration. The event type cannot be changed.
4Switch off / onWhen switched off the front-end event page and all entrances are hidden immediately; claim and payout history is kept. A confirmation appears first: “After switching off, the event details page and entrances will be hidden, claim and payout history will be kept, and Parols can be used normally during the period after switching back on. Confirm?”
When switched on the front-end entrances come back (still following the event stage: event period = all features; redemption period = draws only).
5Status“On” = running; “Off” = not yet launched or force-closed.
DeleteRemoved after a second confirmation — cannot be undone.
⚠️When switching an event “On”, if another Festival Special Event is already on, the system blocks it with 检测到相同活动正在进行中 (“The same event is already running”). Only one at a time.
4

Add / Edit event · Six steps

Click “Add event” or “Edit” to open the wizard. Steps 1–6 are on the left; complete them in order and submit.

Step 1　Event template settings

1Event typeChoose “Festival Special Event”; only then does Step 4 show this event’s dedicated settings.
2Event nameRequired. Shown in the front-end Promotion list (e.g. Christmas Activities 2026).
3CurrencyCurrently fixed to PHP. All reward amounts use this currency.
4StatusOn / Off. Caution Only one Festival Special Event can be on at a time; for the effects of switching off see Chapter 2 ③.
5Event periodEvent start – end (to the minute). Effect Check-in, daily missions and the special mission are all calculated within this period; the event period and Important Dates in the front-end Rules pop-up are filled in automatically.
6Redemption periodCalculated by the system, not editable = 00:00 the day after the end date ~ end time +3 days. E.g. ends 12/31 23:59 → redemption period 2027-01-01 00:00 ~ 2027-01-03 23:59.

Step 2　Event images

Sets the images and display switches across the front end, the same as other event templates.

1Homepage floating bannerWhen on members see the event floating banner on the homepage. Upload PC / H5 images and set the sort order.
2Event listWhen on the event appears in the front-end “Rewards → Promotion” list. Upload the list image and set the sort order.
3RemarksInternal back-office use only; no effect on the front end.

Step 3　Eligible members & lists

1Eligible membersDeposit tier, specified agents, new-member limits, member level, user tags, etc. Members who don’t qualify cannot see the event entrance.
2BlacklistMember accounts that cannot take part. Caution Blacklisted members can see the entrance (homepage floating banner, Rewards page); the pop-up “Sorry / Promotion Ended” appears only after they enter the event details page, and the platform homepage will not show the daily promo pop-up or the next-day make-up pop-up.
💡This step decides who the event is shown to and who can claim. Blacklist vs. other conditions: failing other conditions = cannot see it; blacklisted = can see it but cannot get in.

Step 4　Event conditions (most important, eight sections)

Configure this step top to bottom: Check-in chests → Check-in → Daily rebate → Challenges → Prize pools → Special mission → Bet weighting → Cash bonus wagering. Sections with errors turn red and block the next step, so check each one.

4-1　Check-in chest config (up to 6 chests, 9 rewards each)

1Chest 1–6 tabsUp to 6 chests. Unconfigured tabs show “This chest is not configured”; incomplete tabs are marked red.
2Reward typeCash bonus / Points / Free bet coupon / Free spin coupon / Coupon / Prop card / Golden Draw Ticket / Physical prize. Once any one reward in a chest is filled, all 9 must be filled.
3Reward quantityCash bonus, points and Golden Draw Tickets take an integer greater than 0; coupons and prop cards are chosen from existing settings in the drop-down; physical prizes need a name, value and thumbnail (see below); Golden Draw Tickets also need a fallback cash bonus.
4Win rate0–100, up to 4 decimal places.
5Total win rateThe 9 rewards of each chest must total 100%, shown live below. Caution If not 100%, it turns red, the tab is marked red and the next step is blocked.
What do physical prizes need?
Prize nameUp to 30 characters. Shown in the front-end draw result, History and the back-office Reward Audit remarks.
Prize valuePositive integer, used only for back-office records and reports, not shown on the front end (the Reward Audit amount column shows PHP value).
Thumbnailpng / jpg / gif / webp / bmp, ≤5 MB; a transparent png is recommended. Used in the front-end check-in calendar, chest and prize-pool grids, the win pop-up and the grand prize pop-up.
What is the Golden Draw Ticket “fallback cash bonus”?

When a reward is a Golden Draw Ticket, 抽奖券兜底奖励(彩金) (ticket fallback reward – cash bonus) is required. When the Golden Draw (jackpot) event is off, or the member is on the Golden Draw blacklist, the ticket the member draws is replaced by this cash bonus (no ticket is issued). Back-office records always log it as a cash bonus, with Golden Draw Ticket fallback in the remarks. Applies to tickets in check-in rewards, check-in chests and prize pools.

⚠️Once any one reward in a chest is filled, all 9 must be filled and the win rates must total 100%. If “Extra random chest” is on in Step 4-2, at least 1 chest must be configured.

4-2　Check-in config

1Consecutive check-in daysFixed 3 rows: Day 1 / Day 2 / Day 3 and above.
2Check-in rewardOne reward per row, required. Same reward types as chests, but physical prizes are not allowed.
3Extra random chestOnly the “Day 3 and above” row has this switch. When on, from the 3rd consecutive day each check-in also gives 1 random check-in chest (the front end shows the chest draw). When off, only the check-in reward is given.
4Random chest win rateThe chance of each chest being picked. Only configured chests can be filled; 0 is allowed (that chest is never given); must total 100%.

4-3　Daily rebate config (front-end Parol Quest, by VIP level)

1VIP tabsTargets and rewards are configured separately for VIP0–VIP10. Members see the missions for their current VIP level.
2Apply to other levelsWhen ticked, all other VIP levels use the VIP0 configuration. Caution Once ticked it can no longer be edited.
3Level / Mission condition / Mission target / Reward amountLV1 up to LV20. Condition is “Valid bet” or “Deposit”; targets must increase with each level (for the same condition type); the reward is a fixed cash bonus. None can be blank, 0 or a decimal.
4Challenge “Trigger”When ticked, claiming this level always starts a card-flip challenge (win = boost). If any level is ticked, at least 1 challenge must be set below.
5Bonus item “Give” + quantityWhen ticked, claiming this level also gives N PAROL (not affected by the challenge boost). Quantity is required and must be an integer greater than 0.
⚠️Deposit missions have an extra claim condition: the previous LV (bet or deposit) must be reached before it can be claimed (it doesn’t need to be claimed first). CS is often asked about this — see Chapter 7 Q2.

4-4　Challenge config (not tied to VIP, shared by all levels)

1Challenge 1–5Up to 5; you may set none (then “Trigger” cannot be ticked in daily rebate).
2Reward boostBoost (%) when the flip is won; integer greater than 0, no upper limit. E.g. base 200, boost 25% → win gets 250, lose gets 200.
3Trigger rateWeight for “which challenge is flipped this time”; integer 1–100; challenges 1–5 must not total more than 100%.
4Win chanceThe win rate of that challenge’s flip; integer 1–100, independent for each challenge.
💡As soon as a member enters the event page, the system decides that day’s challenge for each “Trigger” level, and the card shows BONUS +X%; it stays the same all day and is re-decided at 00:00 the next day.

4-5　Special-mission prize pool config (4 fixed pools)

1Pool 1–4All 4 pools are required; incomplete tabs are marked red.
2Item costHow many PAROL each draw costs (positive integer). 5 / 10 draws cost a multiple (e.g. 2 per draw, 10 draws cost 20).
3Rewards (9)Reward types, quantities, physical prizes and Golden Draw Ticket fallback rules are the same as check-in chests.
4Win rateThe 9 rewards of each pool must total 100%. Effect The reward with the lowest win rate becomes the Grand Prize in the center of the front-end grid (if tied, the lowest number wins).

4-6　Special mission config (Christmas Mission)

1Mission conditionFixed to “Valid bet”; not tied to VIP.
2Mission targetEvery time cumulative valid bets during the event reach this number, it counts as 1 completion; repeats without limit.
3Reward quantityHow many PAROL are given per completion. The system settles, issues and updates progress every 20 minutes; any remainder carries over to the next round.

4-7　Bet weighting

1Game typeSlot／Live／Sport／Mini。
2Turnover weightingInteger % from 0–300; blank = 100%. E.g. Slot set to 50: a bet of 1,000 counts as 500.
3Applicable providersFor Slot / Live / Mini, click “Select providers” and tick the applicable ones (none ticked by default; unticked providers count at 100%); Sport applies to all sports providers.
💡This weighting affects both valid bets for daily rebate and bet volume for the special mission.

4-8　Cash bonus wagering multiplier

The turnover multiplier members must complete before withdrawing cash bonuses, applied to all cash bonuses in this event (check-in, chests, daily rebate incl. challenges, prize pools). Can be blank (= no requirement), cannot be 0, up to 2 decimal places; invalid input is outlined in red immediately.

Step 5　Risk control

Sets anti-abuse / duplicate checks (same IP, phone number, name, email, etc.), the same as other event templates.

💡More and stricter risk rules block bonus abuse better, but may also affect genuine members — balance this against your operating strategy.

Step 6　Review & submit

All settings from Steps 1–5 are listed by group for you to check (incl. redemption period, number of chests, check-in rewards, daily rebate, challenges, pool costs, special mission, bet weighting, cash bonus wagering and audit method). If everything is correct, click “Submit”; otherwise click “Previous” to go back. If an earlier step has errors, you are taken back to it automatically with the errors marked.

⚠️Before submitting, check again against Chapter 2 “Key notes” (especially every win rate at 100%, the ticket fallback, the three physical-prize fields, cash bonus wagering and Apply to other levels).
5

Reward Audit: how rewards are paid out

Every reward a member receives goes into “Reward Audit”. The Festival Special Event needs no manual review, including physical prizes.

1StatusAlways “Approved”.
2ReviewerAlways “Auto review”; application time = review time = payout time.
3Remarks (English)Explains where the reward came from and what it is, one per record. Read it to know exactly what the member received.
💡Each reward received = 1 record: check-in and chest on the same day are 2 records; 10 pool draws = 10 records; next-day make-up claims are one record per level. PAROL does not go into Reward Audit (see “Event Item Stats”). For physical prizes, “Reward amount / content” shows the prize value (e.g. PHP 777) and the prize name is in the remarks.

How to read the remarks

Check-in rewardCheck-In Day 1, Cash Bonus PHP 10
= 1st consecutive check-in day, cash bonus PHP 10.
Check-in chestSurprise Chest Day 3, Cash Bonus PHP 50
= chest opened on the 3rd consecutive check-in day, cash bonus PHP 50.
Prize pool drawPool 2, Golden Draw Ticket×3
= 3 Golden Draw Tickets drawn from Pool 2.
Daily missionUser VIP Level 5, LV4 Base Reward 40
= a VIP5 member claimed LV4, base reward 40.
Daily mission (with challenge)User VIP Level 5, LV4 Base Reward 40, Challenge 2 +50%
= as above, and Challenge 2 (+50%) was triggered (the boost only applies if won; see the amount column for the actual amount).
Next-day make-up claimSame format as daily missions, never with Challenge (make-up claims don’t flip cards).
Ticket fallbackPool 1, Reward 100, Golden Draw Ticket fallback
= a Golden Draw Ticket was drawn from Pool 1, but the Golden Draw event is off or the member is on its blacklist, so a cash bonus of 100 was paid instead.
Reward content in English
Cash bonusCash Bonus PHP 40
PointsPoints 100
Free bet couponFree Bet Coupon×2
Free spin couponFree Spin Coupon×2
CouponCoupon
Prop cardProp Card×2
Golden Draw TicketGolden Draw Ticket×3
Physical prizeShows the prize name if there is one (e.g. Pool 4, 大汽车); otherwise Physical Prize
6

Event Report: reading the data

The report has three tabs: Event Reward Stats (how much was paid each day), Event Data Stats (every claim in detail) and Event Item Stats (PAROL in and out).

Event Reward Stats

1TabSame day + same event + same reward type are merged into 1 row; data comes from approved records in “Event Data Stats”.
2TotalsTotal amount / total points / total free coupons above the table, calculated from the current filter results.
3Amount paid (system currency)Total cash bonus of that type for the day (incl. ticket fallback cash bonuses). Participants = unique members; claims = number of records.
4Coupon countTotal count of free bet coupons, free spin coupons, coupons, prop cards and Golden Draw Tickets. Physical prizes show Physical Prize and are not counted in amounts.
5Start date ~ End dateDefaults to today only; to see other dates, change them first and click Search. Rows on the same day are sorted by event ID, then by reward type (Cash bonus → Points → Free bet coupon → Free spin coupon → Coupon → Prop card → Golden Draw Ticket → Physical prize); page through below the table when there is a lot of data.

Event Data Stats

1TabEach reward received = 1 record, consistent with Reward Audit; searchable by member account.
2DaysCheck-in related records show Day N; everything else (incl. next-day make-up claims) shows -.
3StatusAlways “Approved”. Physical prizes show the reward content as Name (Value PHP value).
4Claim timeDefaults to today only. To check a member’s claims on earlier days, change the time range first and search; page through below the table when there is a lot of data.

Event Item Stats (PAROL in / out)

1TabShows how members earn and use PAROL — CS should use this to check “why did my PAROL drop / why didn’t I get it”.
2Record typeAll / PAROL earned / PAROL used. Earned = special mission payouts and daily mission bonuses; used = prize pool draws (one record per draw).
3RemainingHow many PAROL the member has left after this change.
4RemarksFor usage, shows what was drawn, e.g. Cash Bonus 800, Points 1,000, Golden Draw Ticket×3, 大汽车 (Value 777); a fallback cash bonus shows Cash Bonus 100 (Golden Draw Ticket fallback). Earned records have no remarks.

CS guide: what members see on the front end & FAQ

Below are the actual screens members see on their phones, so CS can answer questions quickly.

Event home & daily check-in

① Top of the event page (board + check-in calendar)
② Rules pop-up (RULES)
  • Page header title Reward Details. Board Xmas Reward Board: Cash Bonus Claimed Today = cash bonus claimed in Parol Quest today (incl. challenge boosts, excl. make-up claims, check-in, chests and pools); My Parols = the member’s current remaining PAROL.
  • Check-in: tap “today” on the calendar to check in; from Day 3 a chest pops up first, and check-in is only complete after tapping Draw (closing it = not checked in yet).

Parol Quest: daily missions

① Daily mission list
② Claim All + special mission
  • Buttons: Claim claimable, Bet go bet, Top-Up go deposit, Claimed already claimed (moved to the bottom).
  • BONUS +X% on a card = a card-flip challenge on claim; PAROL badge = extra PAROL on claim. The card amount always shows the base amount; a won challenge boost only counts toward the board and the actual credit.
  • A single Claim plays the gift box animation; if PAROL is given, a PAROL tip follows (enough / not enough to draw). Claim All claims every claimable level for the day at once and then shows the result pop-up.

Deposit mission: previous task incomplete
Final gift box frame (left: no bonus PAROL / right: with bonus PAROL)
PAROL tip (enough to draw: can jump to pools)
Claim All result pop-up

Card-flip challenge (Pili Card Challenge)

① Intro screen (GO)
② Pick one of two cards
③ Result
  • Pick one of two and compare: A ＞ K ＞ Q ＞ … ＞ 2; the member’s card is higher = win. Win = base × (1 + boost%); lose = base amount.
  • The flip cannot be closed midway so the claim isn’t interrupted; if the connection drops and the member re-enters, it restarts from Ready and is never credited twice.

Parol Wish Draw: prize pool draws

① Prize pool (3×3 grid)
② 5 / 10 draws: Congratulations pop-up
③ Grand Prize won: grand prize pop-up
  • Under each pool: 1 Draw / 5 Draws / 10 Draws; PAROL is deducted immediately when tapped, and buttons the member can’t afford turn grey. 1 draw stops on and highlights the winning cell, then shows the win pop-up (1 reward); 5 / 10 draws show the win pop-up when finished.
  • When a physical prize is won: the front end shows Contact Customer Service to claim physical rewards.; for a physical grand prize, Contact CS opens the customer service chat.
  • History at the top right shows the member’s own draw records (one record per reward).
History draw records

Platform homepage pop-ups

Next-day make-up pop-up → make-up success pop-up
Daily promo pop-up
Blacklisted member: error prompt
  • Next-day make-up: if a target was reached but not claimed the previous day, it pops up on every login or return to the homepage; Claim makes up the cash bonus + PAROL in one go (challenge levels don’t flip cards, base amount only), followed by a “claimed” pop-up where VIEW BONUS & MISSIONS opens the event page.
  • Daily promo pop-up: when there is nothing to make up, it pops up once on the first homepage visit each day during the event.

Redemption period

Redemption period (only prize pools available)
  • Redemption period: the Parol Quest button is still shown but cannot be tapped; the page stays on Parol Wish Draw and members can only draw with remaining PAROL; the check-in calendar is disabled and shows no Today highlight.

FAQ

Q1. A member says they bet but the mission progress didn’t move?
A: Daily mission progress uses the member game report as its data source and only updates after the report updates — ask the member to check again later. Progress is also the “weighted” valid bet; if bet weighting is set (e.g. Slot 50%), the number will be lower than the actual bets.
Q2. A deposit mission has clearly reached its target, but Claim is grey and says Previous task incomplete?
A: A deposit mission can only be claimed once the previous LV is reached (bet or deposit; reaching it is enough, it doesn’t need to be claimed). Ask the member to reach the previous level first.
Q3. The special mission (Christmas Mission) PAROL hasn’t arrived?
A: The system settles, issues and updates progress every 20 minutes; no claim is needed, and progress only changes then. Check the member’s PAROL earned records in the back office “Event Item Stats”.
Q4. A member forgot to claim yesterday — can they still claim today?
A: Yes, the next-day make-up pop-up appears on the platform homepage. But only the previous day can be made up; anything older expires. Challenge levels don’t flip cards in make-up claims and only pay the base amount. Make-up cash bonuses are not counted on that day’s board.
Q5. A member says their check-in streak was reset?
A: Missing any day breaks the streak, and counting restarts from Day 1 the next day. From Day 3, check-in only completes after tapping Draw in the chest pop-up; closing it doesn’t count. If the event was force-closed for a whole day, the streak also breaks.
Q6. A member won a physical prize — how do they get it?
A: It has been issued automatically (approved in Reward Audit); CS needs to contact the member offline to arrange shipping / collection. Search Reward Audit by member account; the remarks show the prize name (e.g. Pool 4, 大汽车).
Q7. A member drew a Golden Draw Ticket — why did they get a cash bonus?
A: When the Golden Draw event is off, or the member is on the Golden Draw blacklist, the ticket is automatically replaced by the fallback cash bonus. The Reward Audit remarks show Golden Draw Ticket fallback.
Q8. Is the BONUS +X% on a card only known after claiming? Can it change?
A: The day’s challenge is decided and the boost shown as soon as the member enters the event page; it stays the same all day and is re-decided the next day. Losing the flip pays the base amount only, and the card always shows the base amount.
Q9. Cash Bonus Claimed Today on the board differs from what the member calculated?
A: The board only counts cash bonuses claimed in Parol Quest today (incl. challenge boosts), not make-up claims, check-in, chests or pool cash bonuses. It resets to 0 at 00:00 daily.
Q10. The event has ended — what can members still do?
A: The 3 days after the end are the redemption period, when only draws with remaining PAROL are possible; on day 1 of the redemption period, the last event day’s daily missions can still be made up. After 3 days the entrance closes and remaining PAROL expires.
Q11. A member sees “Promotion Ended” after entering the event details page, but the event is still running?
A: The member is on this event’s blacklist (back-office Step 3). Blacklisted members can see the entrance, but a pop-up appears after entering the event details page and they cannot take part; they also won’t get the homepage make-up or promo pop-ups.
Q12. Do missions change after a member’s VIP level goes up?
A: Daily missions follow the member’s current VIP level. Claimed levels stay claimed; unclaimed ones are recalculated against the new level’s targets. Challenges, the special mission and prize pools are not tied to VIP.
8

Glossary (plain-language)

Festival Special EventThis event’s template name in the back office (Chinese back office: 节庆特别活动; English back office: Festival Special Event). Event types and sources in all reports use this name.
PAROLThe event item (Filipino Christmas star lantern). Earned from the special mission and daily mission bonuses, and only usable for prize pool draws; expires after the redemption period.
Parol QuestThe front-end daily mission tab = back-office “Daily Rebate Config”. Tiered by VIP and reset daily at 00:00.
Parol Wish DrawThe front-end prize pool tab: 4 pools drawn with PAROL.
Check-in chestChristmas Surprise Chest. From the 3rd consecutive check-in day, 1 random chest is opened for 1 reward; it costs no PAROL.
Challenge / card flipPili Card Challenge. When claiming a daily mission with “Trigger” ticked, the member picks one of two cards to compare; win = boost, lose = base amount.
Special missionChristmas Mission. Every time cumulative valid bets during the event reach the target, PAROL is issued automatically, with no limit on repeats; settled, issued and updated every 20 minutes.
Grand PrizeThe reward with the lowest win rate in each pool, placed in the center of the 3×3 grid; winning it shows the grand prize pop-up.
Next-day make-up claimDaily mission cash bonus + PAROL reached but not claimed the previous day, made up via the homepage pop-up the next day; previous day only, no card flip.
Redemption period00:00 the day after the event end date ~ end time +3 days; draws only.
Fallback cash bonusThe fixed cash bonus paid instead of a Golden Draw Ticket when the Golden Draw event is off or the member is on its blacklist.
Valid bet (weighted)Valid bet × bet weighting (100% if not set), used to calculate daily mission and special mission progress.
Wagering multiplierThe turnover required before a cash bonus can be withdrawn; cannot be 0, blank = no requirement.
